help.title: Help and answers
help.intro: Answers on account, safety, messages, appointments and the provider profile.
help.emptyDescription: Articles are coming. Until then, support helps you via the contact form.
help.contactText: Write to support; you get a number and the reply by email. Report content that breaks the guidelines directly.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Write to support, also without an account. You get a number and a confirmation by email; the reply goes to the same address.
contact.appealText: Give the username of the suspended account and why you think the suspension is wrong. Someone other than the person who suspended decides on the appeal.
contact.emailHint: We send the confirmation and the reply here.
contact.emailLocked: Your account’s address. You can change it in the settings.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.messageHint: At least 20 characters. Do not write passwords or ID numbers.
contact.privacy: Support sees your message and your address. Both are kept until the request is resolved and the retention period ends.
contact.sentText: A confirmation is on its way to {email}. Support replies to the same address.

report.title: Report content
report.intro: Report a profile, an organisation or another page of this platform, also without an account. Moderation checks every report; the reported person does not learn who reported.
report.urlHint: Copy the address from the address bar, for example https://…/en/p/name.
report.urgentText: The report goes to trust & safety at once. It does not replace an emergency call.
report.contactEmailHint: Only for questions from moderation; it does not go to the reported person.
report.sentText: Moderation checks it in order; urgent reasons first.
report.sentUrgent: If a minor, exploitation or immediate danger is suspected, the report goes to trust & safety at once. In immediate danger, call the police: 117.
report.sentNext: If the content breaks the guidelines, moderation removes it or restricts the account. If you gave an address, they contact you with questions.
